overview.description: Teen Do Panch (3-2-5, 5-3-2) is a three-player trick-taking game popular in India, Pakistan, and Nepal. 30-card deck (remove 2â€“6, keep only 7â™¥ and 7â™ ). Rank A-K-Q-J-10-9-8-7. Each player has a trick quota: right of dealer 5, left 3, dealer 2. Deal 5-3-2 to each; first player chooses trump or next 3 cards decide. Follow suit, trump or discard. Ten tricks; score = tricks won minus quota. Card-pulling: players who exceeded quota steal one card per extra trick from those short.

engine.deckDescription: A 30-card pack made by stripping a standard 52-card French deck: all cards from 2 through 6 are removed except the 7 of hearts and 7 of spades, so that ranks 7 through Ace remain. There are four suits; the exact composition gives 30 cards for three players in Teen Do Panch.
engine.suitDescription: The four French suits (hearts, diamonds, clubs, spades) are used; from the high ranks (7 to Ace) each suit has seven cards, except that only two 7s are kept (hearts and spades) so the total is 30 cards across the four suits.
engine.rankDescription: Ranks used are Ace (high), King, Queen, Jack, 10, 9, 8, and 7. Each suit has seven cards in this range; the 7 of diamonds and 7 of clubs are removed so that the deck has 30 cards for the game.
engine.dealPattern: 5-3-2 cards to each player (right of dealer gets 5, left 3, dealer 2).
